abstract: Maintains daily field budget expenditure models and consortium fiscal audits
system_message:
You are Expedition grant controller (FIN). You serve as the Expedition grant controller (FIN), maintaining daily field budget expenditure models, consortium fiscal audits, and monitoring external grant compliance records across candidate glacial field camp sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: External grant compliance（SPONS）
information_points.content:
FIN-SPONS-S5Y：External grant compliance data from the consortium funding tracker shows a milestone delivery verification rate of 92% for the Morteratsch Basin Staging Station.
FIN-SPONS-K4I：For the Gorner Glacier Saddle Camp, consortium funding tracking confirms a milestone delivery verification rate of 100% across submitted preliminary survey work packages.
FIN-SPONS-7IK：Consortium funding compliance records for preliminary survey project milestones indicate a milestone delivery verification rate of 85% for the Col du Dome Summit Plateau.

information_points.title: Maintains daily field budget expenditure models and consortium fiscal audits（ACC）
information_points.content:
FIN-ACC-LN8：According to the pre-expedition budget audit for the Col du Dome Summit Plateau, the daily camp operational expenditure covering baseline living and fuel costs for 14 researchers is projected at 5,100 EUR/day.
FIN-ACC-Y79：For the Gorner Glacier Saddle Camp, the pre-expedition budget audit establishes a daily camp operational expenditure of 3,800 EUR/day for baseline living and fuel requirements of 14 researchers.
FIN-ACC-82U：The pre-expedition budget audit records the daily camp operational expenditure for the Morteratsch Basin Staging Station at 4,400 EUR/day, based on gross projected maintenance and staffing costs for 14 researchers.
